profile.intro: Seeking a Full-Stack Software Engineer role where I can apply my experience in MERN, React 18, Node.js, TypeScript, and AI-assisted workflows to build scalable, secure, and user-focused web applications for global teams.
profile.about:
I'm **Moin Uddin**, a **Full-Stack Web Developer** building scalable **MERN, TypeScript, and WordPress** applications. I genuinely enjoy turning complex business ideas into clean, fast, and reliable software.

My journey started with WordPress, PHP, and MySQL business platforms, grew through conversion-focused web engineering, and expanded into full-stack **React 18, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB** systems including **enterprise inventory, POS, and cooperative finance platforms**. I am also skilled in **RAG, AI Automation, Claude, and Agentic AI development** for safer, faster software delivery.

Alongside shipping products, I've mentored learners in **programming, school ICT, and web development**, helping students build real-world technical confidence. From leading full-stack delivery at **TechVelly** and collaborating with engineering teams in Dhaka to supporting remote clients, every project has taught me to value readable architecture and thoughtful user experience.

**Great software feels effortless to use and easy to maintain.** That's what drives me every day.
